negative_findings.description: Every attempted direct fetch of a www.nbrm.mk page (payment statistics EN, statistics hub MK) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, while the same URLs are search-indexed and cross-linked.
negative_findings.result_summary: 2 of 2 attempted www.nbrm.mk .nspx fetches returned 403; nbstat.nbrm.mk fetched fine. Hypothesis: WAF/user-agent filtering, not a dead site. Not verified as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must be planned around a browser-grade fetcher (real UA, JS, cookies) or around direct static file paths (/content/, /WBStorage/Files/) and the NBStat API — a naive HTTP crawler will report the entire central-bank source set as unreachable.

negative_findings.description: The NBStat PxWeb portal root was fetched successfully and exposes only three database trees: External Statistics, Financial Accounts, and Monetary and Interest Rates Statistics.
negative_findings.result_summary: No payment/card/ATM/POS database found in NBStat during this pass; payment statistics appear to remain outside the machine-readable PxWeb platform and to be published as page-attached files on www.nbrm.mk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most collectable channel (PxWeb API) does not currently cover the cell's highest-priority topics, so card/ATM/POS series require file-level scraping and manual schema handling.

negative_findings.description: No standalone, separately-titled periodic 'payment systems report' / 'извештај за работењето на платните системи' landing page was positively identified for NBRSM in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Macedonian and English surfaced the payment statistics page, the MIPS/KIBS pages and the annual report, but no distinct recurring payment-systems oversight report page. It may exist behind the 403 or be folded into the Annual Report.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If such a report exists it would be the densest single narrative source for MIPS/KIBS/card infrastructure; leaving it unlocated risks a systematic blind spot.

negative_findings.description: No current 'статистички билтен' / statistical bulletin product page was confirmed for NBRSM.
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted bilingual search returned only the general statistics and payment-statistics pages; the bulletin may have been discontinued in favour of NBStat, or may be reachable only from behind the 403.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A bulletin would provide a stable, versioned snapshot of many series in one file, which is far cheaper to archive than dozens of individual tables.

negative_findings.description: The NBStat API is referenced in NBRSM's own announcement but no API base URL or documentation page was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Announcement page (ns-newsarticle-soopstenie-18122019-en.nspx) states users can access NBStat data through an API; the concrete endpoint/doc URL was not found. PxWeb's conventional /api/v1/ pattern is a hypothesis only and was not tested.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirming the API base and table registry would turn most monetary/cash-usage collection into a low-maintenance scheduled job.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-grade fetch of platiezhna_statistika.nspx and platiezhna_statistika-en.nspx and diff the attached file lists to determine which language version is authoritative per dataset.

coverage_gaps.description: The actual XLSX/PDF payment-statistics table URLs (per-terminal-type transactions, POS card value, cards issued) were never enumerated because the parent pages are bot-blocked; only a naming pattern (/WBStorage/Files/Platni sistemi_*) and one historical example were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the /WBStorage/Files/ and /content/statistika/ file trees via a rendered crawl of the statistics and payment-systems pages; build a stable file inventory with checksums for change detection.

coverage_gaps.description: KIBS AD Skopje (the clearing house operating the retail net-settlement system) was reached only through the central bank's description page; its own corporate site and volume statistics were not searched in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign a follow-up cell to KIBS AD Skopje's own domain and to CaSys/card-processing operators for operator-published transaction and terminal statistics.

coverage_gaps.description: No advance release calendar for the payment statistics was captured, only the general rule (quarterly within 90 days of quarter end, annual within 90 days of year end) reported for the payment statistics page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and archive the NBRSM statistical release calendar from the statistics hub so collection can be scheduled to publication dates rather than polled blindly.

coverage_gaps.description: Depth of the back-series for card/ATM/POS statistics (earliest available year, methodological breaks) is unknown; a 2019 monetary-statistics change note was seen, implying breaks exist elsewhere too.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Collect NBRSM methodology/change notes under /content/statistika/informacii/ alongside the data so time series can be break-adjusted.

brief: NBRSM is unambiguously the single highest-density primary source for North Macedonia's payment, card, ATM/POS and currency-in-circulation statistics, publishing in parallel Macedonian and English trees on www.nbrm.mk plus a modern PxWeb portal at nbstat.nbrm.mk. The landscape splits cleanly in two: NBStat is machine-readable, API-bearing and fetches cleanly, but in this pass covered only external statistics, financial accounts and monetary/interest-rate statistics (which is where currency in circulation lives) — payment, card and terminal statistics remain page-attached XLSX/PDF files on the main site. Every www.nbrm.mk page attempted returned HTTP 403 while remaining fully indexed and cross-linked, so the whole main-site set should be treated as live-but-bot-defended and collected with a browser-grade fetcher, or via the observably predictable static paths /content/statistika/Soopstenija/ and /WBStorage/Files/Platni sistemi_*. Highest-priority targets are the payment statistics pages (MK and EN, which must be diffed for granularity), the register of payment institutions and payment system operators, the MIPS and KIBS pages, the banking-system indicator tables, and the annual and financial stability reports.
